1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The root marker is where the no-document case meets the rendering clause and the root-id rule; the gate keeps the elaboration sound without testing the marker's form. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
